what: next-look environment: the model change and the learned policy

layout.policy_fit: the fit that made it: its setting, its episodes and the reconstruction values it played with
layout.validation_reference: every reference player under the reward in use, on the validation episodes, with the looks the environment takes by default
layout.validation_reference_on_nominal_looks: the same on nominal looks, measured before the pass list became the default, with the first policy as the learned player
layout.policy_first: the first learned policy, not in use: the weights the tables on record were played with
layout.rewards: the reward in use, the first reward, and which tables were measured under the first
layout.known_limits, setting, episodes, reconst: the first fit, the one that made policy_first: they say how the tables on record were played, not how the policy in use was fitted
layout.learn_from_looks: a variant tried under the first reward and not adopted

known_limits: FIRMS lists detections, not where a satellite looked and saw nothing. Every tile is assumed covered by a pass that flagged anything in the wider context box, and cloud is unknown, so a revealed tile with no detection may have been cloudy rather than free of fire.

setting.spending: every agent spends the budget on the same looks, spread evenly; only the tile differs

rewards.in_use: the score after the look minus the score before it, on one fixed set: every real hidden detection of the episode. The rewards of a round add up to the score at the end minus the score at the start. A look that hands over no hidden pixel earns nothing.
rewards.when_the_tables_on_record_were_measured: the first reward: each look was paid the change in the score on the detections still hidden after it. That scoring set shrank with every look, so the rewards of a round did not add up to the change in its score: a mean gain in this table is a sum of such rewards, not the final score minus the starting score.
rewards.why_they_are_not_measured_again: they are measured on the test episodes, which are windows of the three 2021 test fires. That test is closed, so the tables stay as measured and are labelled. The reward in use is measured on the validation episodes (validation_reference).

reconstruction_parameters: 21 real fire episodes of 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2021 in the plumas_ca, lytton_bc and evia_greece context boxes, the three 2021 test fires excluded (backend/model/episodes.py)

learn_from_looks.what: a look rescales the probabilities of the cells not looked at by the ratio of cells found to cells expected in the tiles looked at, by day and by night
learn_from_looks.rule: used when, on validation episodes, the oracle's mean gain is higher with it and the 90 percent interval of the paired difference (episodes resampled) lies above zero
learn_from_looks.prior_cells_chosen_on: 30 training episodes, by the oracle's mean gain

policy.kind: a linear score per tile for where to look; a linear score per look, one look per stretch of the episode, for when

features.unsure: sum of p (1 - p) over the tile's cells: how unsure the model is there
features.burning: sum of p: cells the model expects to burn
features.power: sum of the model's expected FRP
features.spread: sum of the model's standard deviation
features.modis_recent_frp: MODIS FRP in the tile, halved for every six hours of age
features.modis_recent_pixels: MODIS pixels in the tile, halved for every six hours of age
features.modis_all_pixels: every MODIS pixel in the tile so far
features.seen_before: earlier looks at this tile, each halved for every twelve hours of age (not rescaled)
features.unsure_neighbours: mean of `unsure` over the tiles around it
features.relief: standard deviation of elevation in the tile (0 when no terrain is given)
features.unsure_when_modis_is_old: `unsure` times the hours since the last MODIS pass, capped at twelve, over twelve
features.burning_early: `burning` times the share of the episode's looks still to come

policy.fit: ridge regression of each tile's true reward divided by the largest reward of its decision

fitted_with.reward: the score after the look minus the score before it, on one fixed set: every real hidden detection of the episode. The rewards of a round add up to the score at the end minus the score at the start. A look that hands over no hidden pixel earns nothing.
fitted_with.reconstruction_parameters: 22 real fire episodes of 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2021 in the plumas_ca, lytton_bc and evia_greece context boxes, the three 2021 test fires excluded (backend/model/episodes.py)

training.behaviour_round_0: the best tile half the time, least sure a quarter, random a quarter

when.rule: used when, on training episodes played with weights fitted without their fold, the gain with the look score minus the gain with the evenly spread looks lies above zero at 90 percent (episodes resampled)
when.how: one look in each of as many equal stretches of the episode as the budget has looks: as soon as the look score is in the top share of what the stretch has shown so far, and at the stretch's last look if not before

features.largest_unsure: log of one plus the largest tile sum of p (1 - p): how unsure the model is where it is least sure
features.total_unsure: log of one plus the sum of p (1 - p) over the box
features.largest_burning: log of one plus the largest tile sum of p
features.total_burning: log of one plus the sum of p over the box
features.largest_recent_modis_power: log of one plus the largest tile sum of MODIS power, halved for every six hours of age
features.largest_recent_modis_pixels: log of one plus the largest tile count of MODIS pixels, halved for every six hours of age
features.modis_pixels_last_pass: log of one plus the MODIS pixels in the box within half an hour of the newest one
features.day: 1 on a day pass, 0 at night
features.pixel_area_km2: the look's pixel area, scan times track, from the schedule
features.hours_since_modis: hours since the newest MODIS detection, capped at twelve, over twelve
features.hours_from_previous_look: hours since the previous scheduled look, capped at twelve, over twelve
features.hours_to_next_look: hours to the next scheduled look, capped at twelve, over twelve
features.episode_share_done: the look's index over the number of looks less one

when.fit: ridge regression, on features centred within their episode and divided by their spread, of the reward the least sure tile would pay at each look as a share of the episode's best look; only the selected features are fitted and every other weight is zero

selection.how: forward selection with fires held out: starting from no feature, the feature that raises the held-out figure most is added, until the best addition raises it by less than 0.01 of the evenly spread figure. The held-out figure is the sum of the first-look rewards of the looks the score picks, one per stretch

steps.why: the best addition left raises the held-out figure by less than 0.01 of the evenly spread figure

every_look_feature_at_once.what: the look score with all its features fitted at once: the first form tried. It is not in use

on_training_fires_held_out.what: mean gain over the training episodes, each played with weights fitted without its fold

policy_fit.what: the learned player of the next-look environment: tile weights, look weights, and how they were chosen
policy_fit.known_limits: FIRMS lists detections, not where a satellite looked and saw nothing, and has no cloud mask: a revealed tile with no detection may have been cloudy rather than free of fire. So a look that hands over no detection is taken as unknown: it teaches the model nothing and earns nothing. The looks are the passes of each VIIRS platform whose swath held the whole box, from NASA's pass list, at their real times and pixel sizes; a pass that held only part of the box is not a look. Where no pass list is cached for a window the looks are the nominal half-day slots of each platform instead: the real pass is up to about 90 minutes from a slot's time, sometimes comes twice, and its pixel size is not known in advance.

setting.reward: the score after the look minus the score before it, on one fixed set: every real hidden detection of the episode. The rewards of a round add up to the score at the end minus the score at the start. A look that hands over no hidden pixel earns nothing.

episodes.folds_are: fires grouped by region and year, dealt out in turn

test_protocol_2.what: next-look environment, reference agents and the learned policy on the test episodes, protocol version 2, with the reconstruction values now in use
test_protocol_2.note: second look at the three 2021 test fires: a protocol correction. Episodes are chosen from MODIS rows alone; looks are nominal slots; the policy weights are those fitted under version 1, not refitted.
test_protocol_2.reward: the first reward: each look was paid the change in the score on the detections still hidden after it. test_protocol_2.empty_look: a look that revealed nothing was unknown and paid nothing (nominal looks)
test_protocol_2.values: measured with the reconstruction values in use (refitted from the priors under protocol version 3), which the served round plays with, so that the round and this table agree. The same table with the earlier values (the first fit) is kept as test_protocol_2_m2_values, and the one before the bug fix as test_protocol_2_before_m8c. The learned policy's weights are those fitted under version 1, trained with the earlier values; they were not retrained.
test_protocol_2.bug_fix: measured again after a bug fix. Before it a look kept only the hidden rows inside the window, so a look at a slot laid out just before the window handed over nothing although its pass had flagged fire, and the model took an empty look for a clear one. Now a look owns the rows of its own pass, and an empty look on the nominal schedule is unknown and teaches the model nothing. Same test episodes, same reconstruction values and same policy weights as the table it replaces, which is kept as test_protocol_2_before_m8c.
test_protocol_2.reconstruction_values: 22 real fire episodes of 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2021 in the plumas_ca, lytton_bc and evia_greece context boxes, the three 2021 test fires excluded (backend/model/episodes.py)
test_protocol_2.known_limits: FIRMS lists detections, not where a satellite looked and saw nothing, and has no cloud mask: a revealed tile with no detection may have been cloudy rather than free of fire. On the nominal schedule it may also be a half day on which the platform did not fly or its swath missed the box, so such a look is taken as unknown and teaches the model nothing. The looks are the nominal half-day slots of each VIIRS platform, taken from the platform and the calendar and not from the hidden detections; the real pass is up to about 90 minutes from a slot's time, sometimes comes twice, and its pixel size is not known in advance. A list of real overpass times would remove that approximation.
test_protocol_2.plainly: On the test episodes under protocol version 2 the learned policy does not differ from least sure by more than the noise, and it is not better.

validation_reference.spending: a player that does not choose when to look spends the budget on the same looks as every other such player, spread evenly over the episode, and only the tile differs. least_sure_at_night, least_sure_when_unsure and least_sure_when_sharp choose when, and so does learned; learned_tiles_only is its tile choice on the evenly spread looks
